title: The evening hours
dek: five more prayer altars carry the day past noon — thirty more midjourney pieces
body:
The morning chamber asked for company. Five more altars stand at /prayer-altars-evening, carrying the canonical hours past noon — none in the long light, vespers at sundown, lucernarium at the lamplighting, compline at nightfall, vigil through the dark.

Same approach as the morning: six pieces per station from Mike's Midjourney session of July 18, thirty more images, none shared with the morning chamber, turning on a slow crossfade inside brass frames. Five new tones: slant chord, setting bells, lamp flicker, night bowl, watch drone.

The two chambers share one prayer ledger — ten stations, one feed, perpetual counts. A full day of hours now stands on the point.

Peace be with you, and good night.
